links.outcome: Accuracy/completeness of pathology database generation versus clinicians and general LLMs on same data
links.effect: Lung cancer-specific LLM outperformed nurses, residents, interns, DeepSeek, GPT-3.5 in lesion/lymph node analysis and pathology extraction for Chinese records (p<0.05); total scores slightly below chief physicians.
links.quote: The lung cancer-specific LLM outperformed nurses, residents, interns, and general AI models (DeepSeek, GPT-3.5) in lesion/lymph node analysis and pathology extraction for Chinese records (p < 0.05), with total scores slightly below chief physicians.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a domain-specific LLM for structured pathology report extraction
Measuring clinician task load (NASA-TLX) before and after AI implementation

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-assisted pathology report structuring compared to human clinicians and measures clinical task load (NASA-TLX) pre- and post-AI assistance.
